model.state_leg_normalization: per state, both chambers pooled (best seat in each state = 100); voter_power_national keeps the all-states score
model.house_district_polls: On (polled districts: poll median blended with PVI baseline by poll count; weight = polls/3, max 1)

sources.polling: FiftyPlusOne (fiftyplusone.news), poll CSVs through 2026-10-26 (tracker averages not re-pulled; last as of 2026-10-01) — requires 'Powered by FiftyPlusOne' credit with link; publishing derived scores may require an Enterprise licence.
sources.fundraising: FEC candidate summary (weball26, coverage mostly through 2026-09-30) plus FEC Schedule E independent expenditures (support and opposition counted equally; switch IE_INCLUDE).
sources.partisan_lean: Cook PVI 2026 (derived state PVI for statewide races).
sources.house_ratings: House competitiveness labels are derived bands, cut to Cook Political Report's published House distribution of 2026-10-23 (186/18/16/17/17/13/168); not Cook's per-district ratings.

notes: v46-v50 JSON was produced by patching the v45 export with the changes between workbooks (verified against the v45 export first), not by vm_export_json.py. Regenerate with the exporter from the v50 workbook to make it canonical. full/ and reference/ are unchanged from v45.
